name: appspector
description: Debug iOS and Android apps with AppSpector: HTTP traffic, logs, performance, screenshots and SQLite from live and past sessions, through the aps MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Debug mobile apps from their AppSpector sessions
interface.longDescription: Ask about what your iOS or Android app did: failed requests, error logs, performance, screenshots and its SQLite data, live or from past AppSpector sessions. Uses the aps CLI's MCP server; everything is read-only.
defaultPrompt: Which requests failed in my app's latest session, and why?
Find errors in the app's logs around the last failure
Wait for the next 5xx while I reproduce the bug
